value.rationale: The point-mass perturbation is a canonical singular measure on a zero-free weighted Bergman space. Complete zero-fibre classification for all atom positions/masses and all alpha>-1, the precise first complex-pair threshold alpha>4, sharp critical divergence, and unbounded linear zero-count growth under norm equivalence resolve a motivated quantitative stability question. Mere qualitative existence is prior work and excluded from the claim.
